_note: Visible attributes use a 1-20 scale. Event-group attributes (throws etc.) get added later.

attributes.name: Speed
attributes.description: Maximum sprinting velocity.

attributes.name: Acceleration
attributes.description: How quickly top speed is reached.

attributes.name: Speed endurance
attributes.description: Holding near-top speed as the race goes on.

attributes.name: Aerobic capacity
attributes.description: Size of the aerobic engine (VO2max).

attributes.name: Lactate threshold
attributes.description: Fastest pace sustainable without rapid fatigue.

attributes.name: Running economy
attributes.description: Energy cost of running at a given pace.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Maximal force production.

attributes.name: Power
attributes.description: Explosiveness: force applied quickly.

attributes.name: Mobility
attributes.description: Range of motion and flexibility.

attributes.name: Durability
attributes.description: How much training load the body tolerates.

attributes.name: Running technique
attributes.description: Efficient, relaxed running form.

attributes.name: Starts
attributes.description: Reaction and block/standing start quality.

attributes.name: Race tactics
attributes.description: Positioning, reading the race, timing moves.

attributes.name: Composure
attributes.description: Performing under pressure in big races.

attributes.name: Determination
attributes.description: Refusing to give up; drive in training.

attributes.name: Competitiveness
attributes.description: Rising to the challenge of rivals.

attributes.name: Pain tolerance
attributes.description: Pushing through the hurt late in a race.

attributes.name: Consistency
attributes.description: How reliably ability shows up on the day.

attributes.name: Professionalism
attributes.description: Sleep, diet, recovery and discipline off the track.

attributes.name: Potential
attributes.description: Talent ceiling.

attributes.name: Trainability
attributes.description: How strongly the body responds to training.

attributes.name: Recovery rate
attributes.description: How fast fatigue clears.

attributes.name: Injury proneness
attributes.description: Likelihood of picking up injuries.

attributes.name: Maturation timing
attributes.description: Early, average or late physical development.

attributes.name: Ambition
attributes.description: How high the athlete aims.
